source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.14: the perk card in a fight. Engine review 4, finding 9 (12 Nov 2026): what the Perks tab says about a held item is declared here, not read out of its card text.
notes: One entry per perk (at each tier), trait or skill perk that names the moment it works. `trigger` is that moment in the card's own words, lower case, with no full stop ("when combat starts"); the Perks tab shows it as "Waiting: <trigger>". `standing: true` marks a trigger that is a state or the fight's own start ("while your song plays"): the tab says "Works <trigger>", since there is nothing to wait for. An item with no entry has no moment to wait for ("Active all fight"). `core_wired` lists items the core rules look for by id, with no handler of their own for a fight: passives all the same. `private_count` lists limited passives that keep their count where the card cannot read it: they show their limit, never "Ready". The validator checks every id is a real item; packages/engine/test/perkcard.test.ts checks each trigger is in its card's text and that the two lists are complete.
